working: Constant Contact is connected: 100 campaigns, 330,682 total sends, average open rate 49.18%, well above the ~25-35% health/nonprofit benchmark.

Alumni eNews - Day Of: October 2026 (2026-10-21) was the only recent send with a real lift: +90.0% (27.0 baseline to 51.3 daily sessions), 46.05% open, 1.66% click, 39 email-tagged sessions in 3 days.

Historic best lifts: Client eNews - August (+1263.2%, 3.63% click), Alumni eNews - Reminder: August 2026 (+686.0%), Client eNews - January 2025 (+444.6%). Client eNews December(2) has the top click rate at 10.17% (CTOR-driven, +132.3% lift).
Referring Partners eNews - October 2026 (2026-10-27) had a strong 6.5% click-to-open rate and 1.64% click rate despite a lower 25.28% open rate, so the content resonates with those who open it.
Organic Search is steady at 11,179 sessions (33.2%), up from 11,148 last run, and GSC impression-weighted average position improved to 11.62 from 15.5 (impressions 4,288 vs 2,177).
not_working: UTM leakage persists: Email channel is only 199 sessions (0.6%) across 100 sends, while Direct is 17,190 (51.0%). Recent sends show Direct 3-day sessions of 28-53 against Email 0-11 (e.g. Alumni eNews October: 0 email vs 48 direct).

Most October 2026 sends show negative lift: Staff-Client eNews -35.4% (both arms), Alumni Reminder -29.0%, Alumni eNews -20.3%, Referring Partners -10.1%. Sends are not moving site traffic, or the traffic is mis-credited to Direct.
Staff-Client eNews A/B test (10:00 vs arm B 3:30 PM) shows no meaningful difference: 40.87% vs 40.76% open, 0.69% vs 0.58% click, so send time is not a lever for that list.
Organic Social is 1,712 sessions (5.1%), flat versus last run (1,712), and Paid Social adds 827 (2.5%). Overall click rate averages only 1.67%.
Referring Partners open rate of 25.28% is at the bottom of the benchmark range and far below the 49.18% overall average.
do_next: Add utm_source=constantcontact&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=<send-name> to every link in all newsletter templates, including the Alumni Day Of/Reminder series and Referring Partners, so GA4 credits Email instead of Direct.
Repromote themes from the top click/lift sends (Client eNews August, December, January) and reuse their subject lines and CTAs in the next Client eNews.
Alumni 'Day Of' sends lift best (+90.0% on 2026-10-21 vs negative for Reminder and main sends): test moving the main CTA into the Day Of message and keep it at 1.66%+ click.
Refresh Referring Partners subject lines and sender name to lift the 25.28% open rate toward the 49% list average; keep the strong 6.5% CTOR content format.
SEO: average position improved to 11.62; target the 40 GSC discovery candidates and push pages sitting around positions 8-15 onto page one with internal links and content refreshes.
summary: Window total is 33,674 sessions, led by Direct (51.0%) then Organic Search (33.2%); Constant Contact is connected with a 49.18% average open rate. Newsletter links are almost certainly missing UTM tags (Email only 0.6%), so fixing tagging is the top priority while GSC position improved to 11.62.
